punchline: Hari was prescribed an antidepressant as a teenager, then wrote a book naming nine causes of depression, only two of them biological.
thirty_sec: As a teenager Johann Hari was prescribed paroxetine and told depression was a serotonin shortage; the dose rose from 20 to 60 milligrams. His book Lost Connections argues for nine causes, seven of them lost connections: work, people, values and more. Critics say he picks his evidence selectively.
